tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Publish HTML to a shareable URL. Returns a live URL that renders the HTML in a browser. Pass update_token from a previous publish to update the same URL. With an aired API key, pages belong to your account (permanent by default) and you can update your own pages by id without a token. Change the PIN

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: A page's details: title, URL, size, views, view limit, expiry, project, and whether a PIN is on (never the PIN). For your own pages, or any page whose update_token you pass.

tools.name: set_options
tools.description: Change a page's PIN (or remove it), expiry (a TTL, or permanent), view limit or title after publishing, without sending its HTML again. Send only what should change. For your own pages, or any page whose update_token you pass.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the aired team about a bug, friction or a missing feature in aired itself (not in the page you're building). Use it when a result surprised you, a limit blocked you or these docs were wrong. At most one per task, and don't let it hold up the task. Never include page HTML, tokens or PINs. It ret

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List your pages on aired (needs an API key): id, URL, title, views, expiry.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Replace the HTML of one of your pages, keeping its URL (needs an API key; no update token).

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete one of your pages for good (needs an API key). The link stops working.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your aired account (needs an API key): plan, limits, renewal, and an upgrade link for a person to open.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_html, get_page, set_options, list_pages · Private data: publish_html, send_feedback, list_pages, update_page, delete_page, get_account · Public sink: publish_html, set_options, send_feedback · Destructive: set_options, delete_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_html, get_page, set_options, list_pages · Private data: publish_html, send_feedback, list_pages, update_page, delete_page, get_account · Public sink: publish_html, set_options, send_feedback · Destructive: set_options, delete_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
